chunks.subject: AP Macroeconomics
chunks.title: Q2 Short FRQ (5 points) — Set 1: monetary policy & the reserve market
chunks.content: AP Macroeconomics FRQ 2 (Short), 5 points, one per element (Points 1–5), graphs plus state/explain. Set 1 answer key highlights: state the central bank of Country L would buy bonds; state the central bank of Country A would decrease its administered interest rate; draw a correctly labeled reserve market with the supply curve intersecting the demand curve appropriately; plus related state/explain elements on how the tool affects the money market and interest rates. Common failure: unlabeled reserve-market graph; stating a policy tool without explaining its effect; wrong direction of the open-market operation.

chunks.subject: AP Macroeconomics
chunks.title: Q2 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 2A, 4/5
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 1) scored 4/5 — earned most elements (correct policy-tool statements and the labeled reserve-market graph) but lost one point, typically an explain element or a precise graph feature. Illustrates a strong short-FRQ response one point short.

chunks.subject: AP Macroeconomics
chunks.title: Q2 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 2B, 3/5
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 1) scored 3/5 — earned the policy-tool state points and part of the graph, losing the explain-dependent and precise graph points. Illustrates a mid response with correct statements but incomplete graph/explanation.

chunks.subject: AP Macroeconomics
chunks.title: Q2 Set 1 exemplar — Sample 2C, 2/5
chunks.content: Q2 (Set 1) scored 2/5 — earned only two elements (typically one policy statement and one graph or state point), losing the explanations and the correctly labeled reserve-market graph features. Illustrates a low short-FRQ response.
